question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (5)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage **describes the movement pattern of chimpanzees on all fours.**
 
• The appropriate verb **should indicate a forward movement while supporting themselves on the knuckles of their hands.**
 
• "**Leaning**" fits well because it conveys the idea of moving forward by supporting their weight on their knuckles.
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 5 is** 'leaning.'**
 
• Hence, the correct statement from the passage should read **"****Though able to walk upright, chimpanzees more often move about on all fours, leaning__ forward on the knuckles of their hands (knuckle walking).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other options ("ragging", "making", "stalling") do not accurately convey the sense of the specific movement described.

 
• **Ragging**: "Ragging" means teasing or harassing, which does not relate to physical movement.
 
• **Making**: "Making" is too broad and does not specify the manner of movement.
 
• **Stalling**: "Stalling" means delaying or stopping progress, which is the opposite of moving forward.
